description: Descriptive validation of frozen NY-month first-week outer-rail H1 first touches against native OKX 5m event windows; observation only, no simulated entries, fills, costs, or PnL.

window.strict_reclaim_rule: Lower side close > outer rail; upper side close < outer rail. Equality is not a reclaim.

h1_first_touch_rule: Derive ready_utc as the close of the first complete NY Monday-Sunday week in the event month. Require every original frozen H1 bar from ready_utc through the recorded touch-hour open, inclusive, with no earlier same-side H1 touch; the touch-hour H1 bar must touch the frozen rail.

supplementary_sources.archive_prior_5m_status: Use as an independent full-prefix audit when available. earlier_touch excludes the primary classification; verified and incomplete remain separately identified.
supplementary_sources.v1_overlap: Reuse v1 results only for overlap consistency checks; its strict pre-H1 subset is v1_pre_h1_coverage_status=complete_no_same_side_5m_touch.

primary_5m_source_priority: Use the direct native 5m event window when its complete touch hour matches original H1 OHLC. If the direct touch hour is missing, incomplete, or explicitly unconfirmed, use a complete matching OKX 1m-archive-derived 5m window as a labeled fallback. Do not use archive fallback to hide a complete direct-native OHLC mismatch; mark that source conflict excluded.
